description: For someone in Finland thinking of quitting a job or refusing a job offer: the unemployment benefit waiting period (30 or 45 days), when it starts and ends, and which valid reasons the facts point to (pay under the collective agreement or under 1,134 EUR a month, a commute over 3 hours a day for full-time work or 2 hours for part-time work). matchedReasons means the waiting period may not apply; otherReasons lists reasons to check by hand. Versioned rules, not an official decision. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

commuteHoursPerDay.description: Total commuting hours a day, both ways.

date.description: The last day of employment (quitting) or the day of the refusal, YYYY-MM-DD.

monthlyPayEur.description: Full-time monthly pay of the work, gross EUR.

payBelowAgreement.description: True when the pay is under the collective agreement or the usual pay of the field.

name: check_resign_or_refuse

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.
